bio: Samuel Kelley Forstag (born May 23, 1994) is an American labor union leader, politician, and former smokejumper who is the U.S. representative-elect for Montana's 1st congressional district.

items.q: Forstag's congressional campaign focused on protecting public land, alongside economic issues such as housing and health care affordability.
